The '''corvette-class patrol boat''' was a class of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] employed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Assault" />

==Behind the scenes==
The corvette-class patrol boat was first mentioned in "[[Assault on Repair Station M13 (adventure)|Assault on Repair Station M13]]," a roleplaying game adventure including in the ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''.<ref name="Assault" /> When the adventure was republished in ''[[Classic Campaigns]]'', the reference to the corvette-class patrol boat was replaced with the term "multi-system patrol boat."<ref name="Assault-CC">{{WEGCite|story=Assault on Repair Station M13 (adventure)|book=Classic Campaigns}}</ref>
